items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: My mother gave me a lot of chords on guitars.

ctx.x: Your mother was a guitar player?

My mother gave me a lot of chords on guitars. Oh, really? Yeah, she really was a good guitar player. Yeah, she really was a good guitar player. Mm-hmm. The fact about it, Bill, we all used to get in the kitchen or the bedroom, my two brothers, my father and my mother, and get to get all string instruments and play. Oh, my. And I remember this is good, playing guitar then. The first number I was, they learned me was under the double eagle. So many changes, it was really good too, to hear all them string…
But your brother John is the one that taught you? Yeah, my brother John. Did he just teach you by ear at first or did he try to teach you to read by the way? Well, no, he teach me by ear.
